title: Consolidate missing metrics and tracing gaps in Console during multi-region failover
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Summary: During a production multi-region failover on 2026-02-12 we received escalations from two enterprise customers (AcmeHealth and FinData) reporting missing dashboard panels and incomplete traces in the Console. Missing metrics prevented automated runbook triggers and SREs resorted to manual checks. Root cause spanned three related issues: (1) Prometheus exporter for the runtime lowered cardinality which caused label-based panels to query empty series; (2) the Console's dashboard rendering service had a regression that treated 0-length series as "no data" and hid panels; (3) the tracing ingestion pipeline dropped spans when the sampling header was absent for private deployments due to a header-mapping bug introduced in runtime-1.16.
reproduction_steps: Simulate region failover by routing 30% of traffic to standby region using canary policy
Disable exporter label 'model_variant' to emulate low-cardinality scrape
Send synthetic requests from Private deployment without 'X-Trace-Sampling' header
Observe dashboard panels for per-model latency and tracing flamegraphs in Console
root_cause_analysis: Prometheus exporter: change in metric relabeling in runtime-1.15 reduced cardinality; queries using 'by (model_variant)' returned no series in some slices
Console panel renderer: PR #4987 added logic that hides panels when PromQL returns an empty vector; intended to reduce noise but hides important 0-value series
Tracing pipeline: private deployments used a different header mapping; sampler looked for 'x-rt-sampling' but production agents sent 'X-Trace-Sampling' leading to default 'drop' behavior
proposed_fixes: Rollback PR #4987 to restore display of zero-length/0-value series while we design better UX
Patch Prometheus exporter relabel rules in runtime-1.16 to preserve 'model_variant' label for cardinality-critical metrics; ship as runtime-1.16.1
Add a backward-compatible header mapping in tracing ingestion to accept both 'X-Trace-Sampling' and 'x-rt-sampling' and default to 'sample' for enterprise Private customers
Add unit + integration tests that run a synthetic failover and validate dashboard query results and span ingestion
work_items: ENG-8722: create integration test that exercises failover + exporter relabeling
ENG-8730: implement header-mapping shim in tracing agent
ENG-8741: add dashboard regression tests and update panel renderer UX design
ENG-8755: coordinate emergency patch rollout to affected clusters
rollout_plan: Stage 1: emergency rollback of console renderer to hosted Canary (1 region) + manual verification of panels. Stage 2: deploy runtime-1.16.1 to Dedicated pools with 24-hour monitoring. Stage 3: release tracing header shim to Private images and notify customers. Use feature flags to gate visibility changes. Target full rollout by 2026-03-10.
testing_and_validation: Automated post-deploy smoke: validate 10 synthetic queries against dashboard panels for all model_variant permutations
End-to-end tracing test: generate 1k traces from Private deployment variants without sampling header and assert 95% ingestion success
Load test: ensure exporter relabeling change does not increase Prometheus cardinality beyond threshold
monitoring_improvements: Add an 'observability-health' SLI: fraction of dashboards that return at least one vector in last 5m
Add alert: >10% panels returning empty across customers for 5m triggers PagerDuty P1
Instrument tracing pipeline counters for 'header_mismatch' and create Grafana panel with per-customer breakdown
